dct_description_sm: Ethiopia administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 04. This dataset is structured into 3 levels: - Admin 1: 15 Region - Admin 2: 107 Zone - Admin 3: 1148 Woreda Note: Addis Ababa serves as the national capital and admin1 capital for Addis Ababa and Oromia regions. Dates associated with this dataset: - 01 December 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 01 January 2025: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 01 November 2025: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 01 August 2023: boundaries created by the source Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
dct_publisher_sm: CSA (Central Statistics Agency) + Regional Bureau of Finance and Economic Development (BoFED)
